mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, sku_id, product_name, option_summary, quantity, unit_price, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{optionSummary}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT product_name AS productName, option_summary AS optionSummary, sku_id AS skuId, quantity AS quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity * unit_price AS lineAmount, supplier_status AS status, carrier AS carrier, tracking_no AS trackingNo FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, o.created_at AS orderAt, o.user_id AS buyerId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.option_summary AS optionSummary, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.supplier_status AS supplierStatus, oi.carrier AS carrier, oi.tracking_no AS trackingNo, o.status AS orderStatus FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND p.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_item oi JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id SET oi.carrier = #{carrier}, oi.tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, oi.supplier_status = #{status} WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND p.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
